Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the call this morning — appreciate the clear overview of Redwood's runtime and what a POC would look like. To confirm next steps from our side and what we'll need from you:

- Success criteria: 1) Achieve <100ms median latency for 1k concurrent demo requests; 2) End-to-end cost estimate for our chat workload; 3) No PII exfiltration in sample evaluation set.
- Evaluation plan: We'll run a 2-week pilot with two engineers (Samir and Laura) doing daily runs and a final scorecard.
- Timeline: target start next week (week of Feb 15). Can stretch if provisioning takes longer.

Access requests:
- API key for test environment (short-lived key ok).
- IP allowlist ranges (we'll provide static egress IPs if needed).
- SSO invites for two users (samir.patel@acmehealth.com, laura.green@acmehealth.com).

Can you confirm who will own provisioning and whether any docs/attachments you need from us? We'll also need the DocuSign MOU to sign.

Thanks,
